title: Growth Director, Market Development
location_raw: Remote - Canada - ON; Remote - Canada - BC
description:
At CLEAResult, we lead the transition to a sustainable, equitable, and carbon-neutral energy-efficient future for our communities and our planet. We do that by creating a people-first culture built on trust, accountability, and transparency; where every employee – regardless of position, role, or identity is treated with respect and given an equal chance to thrive.

Additionally, you will enjoy:​
• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance with company premium assistance​
• Life, AD&D, and long-term disability coverage paid for by the company​
• RRSP company match ​
• Paid vacation, sick and personal time​
• Paid company holidays​
• Paid Volunteer Time; giving back to our communities is important to us​
• Employee Referral Bonus Program​
• Employee Recognition Program – convert your recognition points into gift cards​
• Employee Assistance Program – offers benefits to help you manage daily responsibilities​
• Access to training opportunities to advance further in your career

Job Description
Note - we are open to candidates located in the US or Canada. US applicants apply here .

Role Summary
The Growth Director leads capability innovation and management alongside portfolio-level growth strategy, translating enterprise objectives into direction for solutions. This role has broader scope than an individual contributor or manager, influencing executive priorities while owning team-level growth outcomes and budget. It exists to ensure the company's growth strategy evolve with subject-matter depth and consistency within its area of the business.

Key Responsibilities:

- Team leadership: has direct reports and manages one or more workstreams on behalf of the team

- Manages subject matter expertise (SME) and thought leadership for multiple topic areas, and for multiple capabilities; includes expertise in market development, solution development, solution design, & implementation planning

- Manages a budget, including team costs and cross-charging

- Owns categories of goals related to the broader team, and reports on goal metrics on behalf of the team

- Contribute to the enterprise-wide growth strategy, ensuring alignment with long-term company objectives and market positioning

- Influence the executive team on investment priorities and strategic direction, particularly in area of SME and thought leadership

- Responsible for team outcomes, ensuring resources are directed to the highest impact opportunities

- Cultivate strategic partnerships with external stakeholders to expand opportunities

- Delivers client or partner presentations on areas of SME with little preparation and no guidance

- Champion a culture of data-driven decision-making and accountability across the team

- Represent the organization's strategic agenda in industry forums and events

Expected Qualifying Experience:

- Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams to deliver programs, or deliver energy and environmental consulting and management to clients

- Demonstrated leadership in energy program design

- Expertise working with utilities directly in regulated energy markets

- Strong business acumen, and the ability to present team results and goal attainment to senior leadership

- Knowledge of capabilities required to deliver contracted work, along with the capacity to add value as a SME

- Demonstrated leadership in crafting narratives in pursuit of growth project goals

- Industry presence, and ability to present comfortably as a thought leader to internal and external stakeholders

Compensation
$150,000-185,000+
Compensation determined by geographical placement, and relevance of experience

Canadian Commercial Driving Requirements
If applicable, meet all qualification, licensing, medical, and compliance requirements for commercial drivers under applicable provincial and territorial laws, the  Canadian National Safety Code (NSC) , and any federal regulations for extra‑provincial operations, including hours‑of‑service and safety fitness requirements.

Compensation Range
Currency
Type
Salary
Any offered salary is determined based on internal equity, internal salary ranges, market data/ranges, applicant’s skills and prior relevant experience, certain degrees and certifications (e.g. JD/technology), for example.

CLEAResult will not provide sponsorship or support for immigration status or work authorization including for international students. Applicants must be authorized to work in the country where the position is located without the need for employer sponsorship or support. Successful hires must pass pre-employment checks.

Equal Opportunity Employer
As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Employment decisions are based upon job-related reasons regardless of an applicant’s race, color, religion, national origin, marital status, age, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, status as a qualified individual with a disability or protected veteran, or any other protected status.

The above job description and job requirements are not intended to be all inclusive. CLEAResult retains the right to make changes or adjustments to job descriptions and/or requirements at any time without notice.

Job Description
We are looking for a talented individual…

To join our team as a Field Representative . In this role, you will act as a representative to customer organizations, building strong relationships across retail stores, distributors, and HVAC contractors in your assigned territory. You will support a rebate program focused on promoting energy-efficient products, ensuring compliance, and driving program participation.
You will primarily work from your home office while traveling daily within your assigned territory. A structured weekly visit schedule will be provided by leadership. Occasional travel (1–2 times per year) to our Bridgeville, PA headquarters may be required for team meetings.

Location: Gettysburg, PA (Candidates must reside within a commutable distance)
Work Type: Remote / Field-Based
Target Compensation: $20.00/hour

Here at CLEAResult, you will fit right in with our energetic team if you are resourceful, resilient, and kind.

For this opportunity, you’re a great fit if you can…

- Promote energy-efficient products through in-store merchandising, table events, promotions, and training

- Visit retail stores, distributors, and HVAC contractors on a recurring weekly schedule

- Verify point-of-sale materials and rebate-eligible product placements

- Schedule and support promotional events in assigned locations

- Act as the local, on-site program representative to customers and contractors

- Build and maintain relationships to encourage participation and overcome program barriers

- Document all customer and contractor interactions in accordance with program requirements

- Maintain current accounts while identifying and onboarding new opportunities

- Travel extensively throughout a defined territory (Gettysburg region)

In this exciting career opportunity, you will have…

- 0–2 years of relevant retail, merchandising, or customer-facing experience preferred

- High School Diploma or Associate Degree required

- Strong communication and relationship-building skills

- Ability to manage time independently and follow a structured visit schedule

- Willingness to travel locally on a daily basis

This is a safety-sensitive position and may include field work (such as work in industrial/commercial locations and customer homes), warehouse work, or requires driving on behalf of the company. Individuals provided a conditional offer of employment for this position must successfully pass a post-offer, pre-employment drug test and consent to the company obtaining a motor vehicle report evidencing a satisfactory driving record. Applicants for driving positions must hold a valid driver's license, and individuals provided a conditional offer of employment must successfully pass a drug test and maintain a clean driving record as an ongoing requirement for continued employment.
